blurb: Guests board a de Havilland Otter floatplane in downtown Juneau for a flightseeing tour over five glaciers of the Juneau Icefield. Options include a flightseeing tour alone or combined with a landing at the private Taku Glacier Lodge for a salmon feast and wilderness experience. The lodge offers forest trails and storytelling about local history.
extraNote: No flights unless safe and spectacular conditions · Full refund if conditions do not allow views of all five glaciers · YOU'RE ALL SET!
